guidance.purpose: MCP surface registrar for site/carrier binding and materialized Site registry conformance.
first_use: Validate the Site fabric with registrar_site_mcp_fabric_validate before regenerating its materialized registry.
Use mcp_loader_site_tool_inventory_check to obtain an immutable observation_ref from actual child tools/list responses.
Pass observation_ref unchanged to registrar_site_registry_conformance_check; the Registrar resolves it against the target Site root.
Preserve structuredContent as authoritative evidence; text content is for assistant readability.

tool_preference.guidance: Call registrar_site_mcp_fabric_validate for the target Site.
Call mcp_loader_site_tool_inventory_check against the same Site root. Every live tool must explicitly declare readOnlyHint=true or false.
Run pnpm materialize:carrier from the mcp-surfaces workspace. The installed native materializer is the sole carrier-config authority.
Call registrar_site_surface_registry_sync only when the Site fabric and catalog are intentional.
Call registrar_site_registry_conformance_check with the Loader observation_ref. Status ok is the authority projection proof.
Repair drift at its owning layer: surface annotations, Site fabric, registrar catalog, or materialized registry generation.

anti_patterns: Do not infer mutation semantics from tool names. The live surface must declare readOnlyHint explicitly.
Do not treat a tools/list name match as full conformance; classification, provenance, partition, projection, and output-reader closure must also pass.
Do not copy or hand-build observation maps; pass the immutable Loader observation_ref.
Do not regenerate a registry to conceal drift in a surface annotation or Site fabric declaration.
Do not bypass the owning surface with shell scripts when a governed MCP tool exists.

Do not edit a carrier config paired with .narada-generation.json. Use mcp-loader for progressive attachment or Registrar binding tools for an intentional static binding; direct edits invalidate the shared carrier generation.
recovery: For unknown_tool, call tools/list and this guidance command again after restart.
For missing live observations, rerun mcp_loader_site_tool_inventory_check and pass its new observation_ref.
For live_tool_semantics_partition_incomplete, add an explicit boolean readOnlyHint at the owning surface; do not default it.
For registry drift, repair the named layer and then rematerialize and rerun the full proof.

If mcp-registrar itself cannot start because carrier materialization is stale, use the direct native bootstrap recovery (not an MCP call): run pnpm materialize:carrier from the mcp-surfaces workspace. It invokes the installed immutable Rust authority without building the JavaScript workspace; restart affected carrier sessions afterward.
Canonical native recovery always rematerializes the complete declared carrier set transactionally. It has no single-carrier escape hatch.
For unclear behavior, submit surface_feedback_submit with reproduction steps, expected behavior, and impact.

when: guidance is missing, stale, or contradicted by live behavior
schema shape makes correct usage hard
errors hide the actionable refusal or recovery path

boundaries: The registrar materializes and verifies authority declarations; it does not infer policy from names.
MCP Loader owns fresh child attachment and live tools/list observation.
Observation created_by and payload-id checks are declarative lineage guards, not cryptographic provenance or authority.
Each owning MCP surface remains authoritative for execution policy and domain enforcement.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_self_certification_preflight

body.description: Optional body/chapter/packet text to include in target and terminal-claim detection.

actor_principal.description: Optional actor/closer/reviewer principal if not already in the packet.

terminal_correction_claim.description: Set true when the surface would assert terminal correction/closure.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_admit_evidence
tools.description: Canonical action: admit evidence (task_lifecycle_admit_evidence). Admit evidence for a task through the admission gate (report, verification, criteria).

task_number.description: Task number to admit evidence for.

self_certification.description: Optional self-certification guard packet for closure-sensitive architect-failure/deception/trust evidence.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_prove_criteria
tools.description: Canonical action: prove criteria (task_lifecycle_prove_criteria). Auto-check all acceptance criteria in the task body and run evidence admission. task_number.description: Task number to prove criteria for.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_closeout
tools.description: Canonical action: closeout (task_lifecycle_closeout). Readable alias for task_lifecycle_disposition_closeout. Mutates task notes, inbox disposition evidence, criteria, and finish state only when requested by arguments.

envelope_id.description: Optional envelope id. If omitted, the task body is scanned for env_<id>.

disposition.description: Optional disposition label, e.g. already_promoted, acknowledged, dismissed, no_code.

dry_run.description: Plan without writing task notes or finishing.

prove_criteria.description: Auto-check criteria after writing notes. Default false.

finish.description: Finish the task after writing/proving. Default false.

changed_files.description: Explicit changed-file evidence for the optional finish report.

no_files_changed.description: Explicitly declare that the optional finish legitimately changed no files.

include_unrelated_changed_files.description: If true, include all git-changed files under the site root in the finish report. Default false scopes to task-relevant paths.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_disposition_closeout
tools.description: Canonical action: disposition closeout (task_lifecycle_disposition_closeout). Prepare or complete a lightweight inbox-disposition close-out: resolve envelope status, write execution/verification notes, optionally prove criteria and finish, and return task-owned changed files.

envelope_id.description: Optional envelope id. If omitted, the task body is scanned for env_<id>.

disposition.description: Optional disposition label, e.g. already_promoted, acknowledged, dismissed, no_code.

dry_run.description: Plan without writing task notes or finishing.

prove_criteria.description: Auto-check criteria after writing notes. Default false.

finish.description: Finish the task after writing/proving. Default false.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_audit

until.description: ISO timestamp end. Defaults to now.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_submit_report
tools.description: Canonical action: submit report (task_lifecycle_submit_report). Readable alias for task_lifecycle_finish. Finish a claimed task by submitting a report. If the task has an outcome contract, include outcome and optional findings; contract_id is inferred from the task. Use payload_ref only for long companion fields; top-level task_number and agent_id remain authoritative.

directive_id.description: Optional first-class directive id that caused this report. Prefer this structured field over summary tokens.

outcome.description: Structured outcome for tasks with an outcome contract. Allowed values are inferred from the task contract, for example accepted, accepted_with_notes, rejected, completed, or blocked.

findings.description: Structured findings for outcome-contract tasks. Use [] when there are no findings.

evidence_refs.description: Optional evidence references supporting the structured outcome.

reviewer.description: Optional admitted reviewer agent id or unique reviewer role alias for the generated review-contract dependency routing.

changed_files.description: Explicit changed-file evidence for this finish report.

no_files_changed.description: Explicitly declare that this finish legitimately changed no files.

include_unrelated_changed_files.description: If true, include all git-changed files under the site root in the finish report. Default false scopes to task-relevant paths.

authority_basis.description: Required when conflict-of-interest policy allows explicit operator override for an outcome-contract dependency task.

recovery_truthfulness.description: Required for serious-failure recovery finish/report claims. Fields: known_facts, inferences, uncertainty, changed, not_changed, remaining_work, evidence_limits, capa_open_status, state. terminal_corrected additionally requires repository_durability / commit-push state plus no open residual work.

self_certification.description: Required for architect-failure/deception/trust same-subject terminal correction claims. Fields: target_category, subject_principal, requires_independent_review, misleading_completion_answer, allowed_pending_state, plus independent_review_ref/reviewer_eligibility_ref or operator_acceptance_ref for terminal same-subject correction.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref carrying long finish/report companion fields such as summary, changed_files, outcome, findings, recovery_truthfulness, or self_certification. Payload fields are merged with top-level arguments; top-level task_number and agent_id win.

Use after dependency satisfaction reports disposition_required=true; required_outcome_id is inferred from the latest outcome when omitted.

target_task_id.description: Optional task_id for remediation_task or covered_by_existing_task disposition.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

limit.description: Maximum results; defaults to 8.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_review
tools.description: Canonical action: review (task_lifecycle_review). Compatibility migration tool for legacy review calls. Normal review work should be a review-contract dependency task finished with task_lifecycle_finish. This tool preserves old review-row readback while admitting dependency/outcome authority. For long findings, create payload { findings: [{ severity, description, location? }] } and retry with payload_ref plus top-level task_number, agent_id, and verdict.

task_number.description: Legacy parent task number being reviewed.

agent_id.description: Reviewer agent id for compatibility migration.

verdict.description: Legacy verdict mapped to a review outcome: accepted, accepted_with_notes, rejected.

single_operator_review.description: Set to true to allow and annotate a same-operator review (reviewer and finisher share operator_identity).

auto_accept_single_operator.description: Set to true to automatically accept and annotate a same-operator or singleton-role review in one call.

self_certification.description: Optional self-certification guard packet for architect-failure/deception/trust review.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_executability_status

authority_basis.description: Authority basis for creating the recurrence definition.

goal.description: Task goal markdown used for generated instances.

context.description: Task context markdown used for generated instances.

required_work.description: Required work markdown used for generated instances.

non_goals.description: Non-goals markdown used for generated instances.

tags.description: Tags copied to every generated task instance.

evidence_requirements.description: Evidence expected from each generated run.

target_role.description: Target role for generated task instances.

preferred_role.description: Preferred role for generated task instances.

schedule_timezone.description: Schedule timezone metadata. V1 due calculation uses UTC; defaults to UTC.

initial_status.description: Initial status: draft or active. Defaults to active.

payload_ref.description: Optional immutable payload ref for long arguments such as summaries, evidence packets, or changed_files.

tools.name: task_lifecycle_recurring_run_due
